title: Interacting Dark Sector field theory with phantom crossing
efc_relevance: Fermionic DM Yukawa-coupled to a tachyonic Born-Infeld scalar produces a double phantom crossing in w(z), constrained by DESI DR2 BAO + Planck 2018 + SNe. Mechanistic cousin to EFC's L2→L3 entropic crossing and to arXiv:2604.21671 saturation kernel; the double-crossing signature is a sharper discriminator than the single-crossing CPL pair.
ledger_action: Add to competitor-landscape ΔAIC table as fermionic-Yukawa dark-sector cousin; cross-reference framework:CoupledDE-DM-Amendola2000, framework:Quintom-Feng2005, and arXiv:2604.21671; required double-vs-single-crossing comparison row in WP3 Falsification Protocol — EFC must state whether its L2→L3 produces one or two w=−1 crossings.
